rule_first_buy: First BUY print (lift ask) that rounds to a tick, held to official resolve.
rule_band: First BUY whose rounded price is inside [min, max] after the tail window opens. This is what favorite_min/max + favorite_window_seconds does.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 14d, 4007 resolved, first BUY print in window, 7% fee, hold to official resolve

safest_tick_if_you_can_fill.why: Lowest reverse rate among taker combos whose 95% CI still clears fee breakeven. Reverse 1.43%, wr 98.57%, +0.44¢/share. 98¢ last 30/45s is −EV. 99¢ never clears breakeven as a taker BUY.

best_ev_tick.why: Highest pnl/share among large-n BUY rows. Reverse 2.55% but win pays ~4.7¢ vs 99¢ paying 0.93¢.

best_balance.why: 96¢ last 3 minutes: reverse ~2.0% (better than 95), EV +1.75¢/share (4× 98¢). CI clears breakeven cleanly. 25.8 wins offset one $25 blowup vs 53 at 98 and 106 at 99.

best_window.why: 180s and full 5m (300s) are almost the same tape. 900s adds nothing. Last 30–45s is adverse selection: 97/98/99 go −EV; 96 stays barely +EV; 95@30s is flat.

bot_settings_if_following_tape.note: Band 96–98, last 3 minutes. Skip 99 as taker. Do not stack. Snapshot-99 with 30s left is safer (0.11% reverse) but that ask is usually gone after itode.

recommendation.vs_14d: The extra 16 days were choppier. Last-180s reverse rose: 95¢ 2.58%→3.26%, 96¢ 1.99%→2.47%, 97¢ 1.82%→2.23%, 98¢ 1.43%→1.71%, 99¢ 1.12%→1.17%. 98¢ last 180s is still +0.16¢/share but the 95% CI no longer clears fee breakeven. 99¢ last 180s CI [98.58%, 99.04%] sits entirely below the 99.07% wr needed. 96–97 last 3 minutes remain the robust +EV band; skip taker 99; avoid last 30–45s.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 30d, first BUY in band after window opens, 7% fee, hold to official resolve

bot_settings_if_following_tape.why: Keep current 96-98 last 3 minutes. 90-92 last 5m wins on EV but will trip the $50 circuit. 97 last 3 min is the fewest steamrolls. Do not add 99.

max_ev.why: Highest pnl/share on 30d tape. 90¢ last 5m +3.75¢/share, reverse 5.63% vs 9.37% fee breakeven. 91¢ +3.49¢ / 4.94%. Incompatible with a $50 daily circuit if you fill most 5m books (~400 blowups / 30d).

safest_plus_ev.why: Lowest reverse among CI-clearing bands: 2.18%, +0.62¢/share, 180 losses / 8251.

best_for_this_bot.why: Current settings. First fill averages 96.4¢ so the band behaves like 96 not 98. Reverse 2.59%, +0.78¢/share, CI clears. Tightening to 96-97 last 180s is the robustness upgrade; dropping 98 is optional.

playbook.window_rule: 90-96¢: longer is better (240-300s ≈ full 5m). 97¢: last 180s is enough. 98¢ needs ≥120s and is only point +EV. 99¢ never +EV as taker. Avoid last 30-45s from 93¢ up.
playbook.pnl_note: Headline $25/fill totals IGNORE the $50 circuit and assume ~270 fills/day. 90 last 5m unclipped +$8,572/30d vs circuit-stop ~+$37/day. Current 96-98 last 180s unclipped +$1,697/30d vs circuit-stop ~+$15/day. 99 last 180s is genuinely -EV (85 wins/loss vs 106 needed).

honest: A wide cheap band (90–99 last 5m) fills at the first 90¢ print, then has the whole window to get steamrolled.
99¢ is not certain. One dump after you lift is −~99¢/share vs +~0.93¢ if you win.
Prints that already traded are not a 250ms FAK fill. Live fill rate is lower.
5m books can trade before the BTC window; this study keeps last 900s of tape only.
Headline dollar PnL assumes every 5m fill and no $50 circuit. That is the main water.
One reverse still costs ~$25. 90¢ needs ~10 wins to offset; 96¢ ~26; 99¢ ~106 and does not cover.

honest: Dollar totals assume every qualifying 5m book fills at $25. Live FOK, scan_limit, and a $50 circuit cut this a lot.
90¢ last 5m is ~5× the 96–98 last-3m dollar PnL and ~2× the blowups; the circuit will clip it.

accounting.question: Are the pretty dollar totals inflated? Does one reverse wipe many wins?
accounting.short: Reversal math is real and fees are included. The $8k / $1.7k totals are inflated because they assume every qualifying 5m book fills at $25 and the $50 daily circuit never fires. One reverse still costs ~$25; 90¢ needs ~10 wins to offset, 96¢ ~26, 99¢ ~106. 99¢ sample does not cover. With the circuit, 90¢ collapses from ~$286/day to ~$37/day (stop after ~2 losses).
water_in_headline_pnl: No circuit: 90¢ has ~16 blowups/day expected; $50 limit stops after ~2 (~$50). Unclipped 90¢ totals are ~8× too high vs that cap.
Fill count: 8200–8600 fills / 30d ≈ 270/day. Live FOK + scan_limit + one-position cap is far fewer.
First BUY print already traded; your 250ms FAK/FOK fill rate and price are worse.
Per-tick tables can double-count a market if both sides printed the tick; use band rows for bot PnL.
Tape size sometimes < $25; we still booked $25 notional.
Blowups cluster on dump days; circuit + variance worse than independent-loss model.
not_fake: Win/loss dollar split: 90¢ last 5m gross wins ~$20k vs gross losses ~$12k. Net is after those blowups, not before.
99¢ is already negative after the same accounting (need 106 wins per loss, sample only 85).
